usedFor: Pitchit holds your leads, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers when “When a lead's priority changes” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's priority changes” in Pitchit, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A change in lead priority can start a script on your own machine, such as a report export.

watchOut: “When a lead's priority changes” fires for any lead in the account, so the command can run often.
